messages.subject: vtest and R versions
parts:
Hi everyone -

I just updated to R 2.15.0 and found that it I started getting false positives for file changes with vtest. It turns out that when R generates a PDF file, it embeds a string with the R version: "/Producer (R 2.15.0)". I've changed the vtest code to zero this out, with "/Producer (R 0.00.0)".

I've re-run all the previous ggplot2 tests with the new version of vtest, rebased them, and pushed them to the vtest repo.

Practically speaking, this means that if you've downloaded the previous test results, you will have to replace them with the new ones by running the following (starting in your ggplot2 dir):
  cd visual_test/vtest
  git fetch
  git reset --hard origin/master

You should also update to the latest vtest with:
  install_github('vtest', 'wch')

If you haven't used vtest before, you don't have to do anything. :)

-Winston
